note: Mario Kart DS art for the randomizer, all through Super Mario Wiki's file host (mariowiki.com), game assets only: the in-game character mugshots from the character select screen (40px pixel art, drawn at 4x with nearest-neighbour so the pixels stay sharp), the in-game course icons and battle course icons (drawn at 3x the same way), the in-game cup emblems, and the karts and Mission Mode bosses as the game's own 3D models rendered from the game data (the pictures the wiki's kart tables use; the game has no official artwork for most of its 36 karts). The header is the official group artwork of Mario, Peach and Luigi with a Blooper, cropped to 16:9. Run scripts/pull-mario-kart-ds-art.ts.
